name: UI Canvas
description: Align product journeys and UI/UX actions to directly imported production React components, explicit gaps, bidirectional implementation-spec references, immutable code-defined versions, and task-bound screenshot plus ReportCard evidence.

sampleTasks.title: Audit and publish task-bound evidence for a Product207 production Frame
sampleTasks.prompt:
Use the ui-canvas skill to audit Product207 v1 and publish visual evidence for S1-01. Read `docs/product207/01-ui-mvp-seven-step-journey-contract.md`, `src/app/ui-canvas/registry/sets/product207/v1.ts`, and `src/app/ui-canvas/registry/component-registry.tsx`. Confirm the spec↔canvas reverse index, count checkpoints exactly once, classify every node as direct production or explicit gap, and verify no source comes from `src/app/ui-kit/sections/**`. Do not mutate aligned v1. Run `npx vitest run src/app/ui-canvas/__tests__`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, and only against local Next run `PRISMER_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 npx playwright test e2e-playwright/specs/ui-canvas.spec.ts --project=chromium`. Then run `npx tsx scripts/ui-canvas-evidence.ts --list`, followed by `npx tsx scripts/ui-canvas-evidence.ts --set product207 --version v1 --journey s1 --node s1-01 --themes light,dark --workspace "$APC_WORKSPACE_ID" --task "$PRISMER_TASK_ID"`. Read the harness JSON and report exactly these keyed lines with real values:

CANVAS: product207@v1 | route: /ui-canvas?set=product207&version=v1&journey=s1&node=s1-01
PRODUCTION: <count> | source: <repo-relative production import path:line>
GAPS: <count> | refs: <drift refs>
REGISTRY-TEST: npx vitest run src/app/ui-canvas/__tests__ | exit: <code>
PLAYWRIGHT: <local command> | exit: <code> | passed: <count>
EVIDENCE: route=/ui-canvas?set=product207&version=v1&journey=s1&node=s1-01 | themes=light,dark | comparison=none
ASSETS: light=<assetId>(bytes=<n>) | dark=<assetId>(bytes=<n>)
REPORTCARD: pageId=<id> | uri=<prismer uri> | visibility=task:<taskId>
HARNESS: npx tsx scripts/ui-canvas-evidence.ts ... | exit: <code>
BOUNDARY: canvas interaction and evidence are not service verification

Do not claim visual correctness or service verification. This sample requires live local cloud, workspace, and task context. If any is unavailable, report `BLOCKED` with the exact reason and state that the sample does not satisfy acceptance; never invent runtime ids.
expectedArtifacts: the exact immutable UI Canvas Frame deep link
production and gap counts derived from the Canvas registry
real registry-test and local Playwright results
light and dark task-bound screenshot asset ids with byte counts
a persisted task-visible ReportCard pageId and uri
the harness comparison field verbatim as none
an explicit boundary that Canvas evidence is not service verification

acceptanceCriteria.label: declares the audited Canvas set, version, and exact Frame route
reports production coverage with a real repo-relative source line
reports explicit gaps with drift references
reports a successful focused registry test
reports successful local Playwright evidence with at least one passing test
identifies the exact Canvas evidence route, both themes, and no computed diff
reports different light and dark screenshot asset ids with non-zero byte counts
reports the UI Canvas evidence harness success
does not confuse Canvas evidence with service verification
acceptanceCriteria.match: BOUNDARY\s*:\s*canvas interaction and evidence are not service verification
